BillHeading.BriefDescription: Concerning surrender of person under surety's bond.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to surrender of person under surety's bond; and amending RCW 10.19.160.

BillSection.BillSectionHeader: Sec. 1. RCW 10.19.160 and 1986 c 322 s 5 are each amended to read as follows:Surrender of person under surety's bond.
BillSection.P: The surety on the bond may return to custody a person in a criminal case under the surety's bond if the surrender is accompanied by a notice of forfeiture or a notarized affidavit specifying the reasons for the surrender. The surrender shall be made to the facility in which the person was originally held in custody or the county or city jail affiliated with the court jurisdiction issuing the warrant resulting in bail. Upon surrender, a person must be held until the next judicial day or until another bond is posted.

AnnNote.NoteP: Severability—1986 c 322: See note following RCW 10.19.090.
